name: fire
description:
this mint is created to support people in my hometown who have been affected by the wildfire, those whose homes have been evacuated and who are currently on the streets without access to electricity, water, or food. all proceeds will go directly to those in need.

you can follow every detail transparently through my account: [https://x.com/gruffwashere](https://x.com/gruffwashere)

i love you all, thank you.
